Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBreakEvenEconomicsReceipt

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBreakEvenEconomicsReceipt
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBreakEvenEconomicsReceipt extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable break-even and first-order price-sensitivity receipt for qualified hydrotreating screening economics.

Each break-even value changes one caller-owned price or cost at a time while holding the other qualified scenario terms fixed. The results are algebraic screening values, not market forecasts, optimization results, or investment recommendations.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1
